_comment: Illustrative baseline parameters for the GPU duopoly simulator. These are scenario inputs from the React prototype, NOT measured NVIDIA/AMD data. Do not use for any empirical claim.
price_unit_label: model price units (illustrative; not calibrated USD forecast)
notes: Baseline values inherited from the React prototype (gpu-duopoly-model.jsx). They are illustrative placeholders only. D is derived as substitutability_ratio_D_over_B * B = 0.48 * 2.5 = 1.2.
